subject: AlluMed launch: CS ownership & initial milestones
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Joseph Allen <joseph.allen@allumed.com>, Lina Patel <lina.patel@allumed.com>, procurement@allumed.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: AlluMed launch: CS ownership & initial milestones

Team — forwarding the final materials from the close. AlluMed committed to go-live week of May 6 (internal target is May 10) and will primarily use the Redwood hosted API for inference. Quick summary and asks below.

Deal context: closed 2024-04-15; committed usage profile is 200M tokens/month after ramp. SOW attached (AlluMed_SOW_v2.pdf). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-ALLU-2024-0317

Key customer contacts:
- Joseph Allen (Product lead) — joseph.allen@allumed.com
- Lina Patel (Integration lead) — lina.patel@allumed.com
- Procurement — procurement@allumed.com

Proposed ownership (please confirm):
- Primary CS owner: Marissa Cole — overall onboarding, success plan, weekly checkpoints
- Technical owner / S2CS: Karthik Iyer — infra, model config, quantization guidance, test harness
- Billing & ops handover: Sergio Alvarez (I’ll stay on for first two weeks to finish billing/comms)

Initial milestones (timeline to agree):
1) Pre-kickoff intake form & credentials requested (due Apr 23)
2) Technical kickoff (Karthik lead) — week of Apr 29
3) Integration & test plan, sample prompts & throughput baseline — May 1–8
4) Staging validation & stress test — May 9–13
5) Go-live target — May 10 (soft), full ramp by May 20

Open items we need from AlluMed (Joseph / Lina):
- Confirm VPC peering or preferred secure path for API traffic
- Provide sample prompt sets and representative utterance sizes
- PO and billing contact (Procurement said they will send PO)

Attachments: AlluMed_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)

Asks: Marissa — can you confirm you can own the success plan and start weekly standups after the technical kickoff? Karthik — can you review infra items below and add any missing infra blockers? I’ll coordinate procurement and verify contract items.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
[Attachment: AlluMed_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the clear plan. We’re aligned on the May 10 soft go-live window. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Procurement will send PO_1234.pdf today (attached) — payment terms 30 days.
- We need to confirm DPA language and a contact for security evidence (SOC2). Who should we send that to?
- Lina will be the integration owner and will join the technical kickoff.

Joe

joseph.allen@allumed.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Joseph Allen <joseph.allen@allumed.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2024 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlluMed launch: CS ownership & initial milestones

Sergio / Karthik — happy to own this. I’ll open the CS intake and populate the success plan template today.

Pre-kickoff items I’ll own (to be completed by Apr 23):
- Intake: business goals, KPIs, escalation path, test cases (I’ll send the intake doc link once populated)
- Weekly standup cadence: propose Tue 30m sync starting Apr 30 (I’ll invite Joseph & Lina)
- Training plan and decision tree for fallbacks (will coordinate with Karthik on model variants)

Quick question on security evidence — Sergio, can you share SOC2 contact or drop the report to the drive link you referenced? I’ll need it for the intake doc.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Joseph Allen <joseph.allen@allumed.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2024 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlluMed launch: CS ownership & initial milestones — infra checklist

Couple of technical notes from my review of the SOW and the expected workload:
- Expected token mix: 60% short prompts (<64 tokens), 40% long-form (averaging 220 tokens). We should size batch config for 128/256 to avoid latency spikes.
- VPC peering is preferred for data residency; if they cannot support peering we should agree on a private NAT + strict IP allowlist.
- Need sample prompt sets and a redaction plan for PHI — request Lina for sanitized examples before the technical kickoff.
- I attached an infra checklist (infra_requirements.xlsx) with specific ports, allowed CIDRs, and expected QPS headroom.

Blocked until we get:
1) VPC or allowlist details
2) Example prompts (sanitized)
3) Procurement confirmation on billing account (Sergio to confirm)

I’ll schedule a 45m technical kickoff once we have VPC details — propose Apr 30 at 11:00 AM PT.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior SRE / Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: infra_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Joseph Allen <joseph.allen@allumed.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Apr 2024 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlluMed launch: CS ownership & initial milestones — confirmed owners & next steps

Thanks all — quick update and confirmations:
- Marissa: confirmed primary CS owner; please send the intake doc and first weekly invite for Apr 30.
- Karthik: confirmed tech owner; please lead the Apr 30 technical kickoff (11:00 AM PT tentative).
- Procurement: received PO_1234.pdf, accounts team will create billing account under DEAL-ALLU-2024-0317.
- Security/SOC2: Monica Patel (cc’d) from our security team will send the SOC2 summary and DPA linkage to Joseph & procurement by EOD Mon Apr 22. Monica, can you confirm?

Joseph/Lina — appreciate the quick turnaround. Lina, if you can send sanitized prompt examples and preferred connectivity option (VPC peering vs IP allowlist) by Apr 23 we can lock the kickoff.

I’ll remain on the thread through go-live for three check-ins, then transition fully to CS.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
